title: Lists and Iteration
introduction: A list groups related values so one algorithm can process any number of items.
learningOutcomes: Use accumulators to calculate a result.

activities.question: Which loop is clearest when every list item should be processed once?
activities.explanation: A for-each loop expresses traversal of every item without manual position management.

activities.question: A variable that collects a running total is an ___.
activities.explanation: An accumulator is updated during iteration to build a result such as a total.

activities.question: Removing items while traversing the same list can require special care.
activities.explanation: Removal can shift positions or invalidate an iterator, causing skipped items or errors.
